judgments.reason: The vignette explicitly states 'CD4 count <20 cells/µL', which is a CD4 count far below 200 cells/µL and directly supports characterizing the HIV-associated immune suppression as severe.
The vignette explicitly states 'HIV viral load of 191 000 copies/mL', which is a high viral load that clinically supports severe HIV-associated immune suppression alongside the very low CD4 count.
